newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy minister says could bring '98 budget forward.
newsitem.headline: Italy minister says could bring '98 budget forward.

text.p: Italian regional affairs minister Franco Bassannini on Wednesday said parts of Italy's 1998 financial budget could be brought forward to ensure Italy meets the parameters for entry to Europe's single currency.

"If it is necessary, nothing prevents us bringing forward some of the effects of the measures planned for the 1998 budget bill to guarantee meeting the EMU parameters," he said while attending a conference here.
Asked what those measures could be, he said a serious government decides on measures and then announces them.

Earlier today, the European Commission released its forecast showing that Italy's deficit to GDP ratio would be 3.2 percent in 1997 compared to the three percent target set to join Europe's Economic and Monetary Union scheduled for 1999.
